keyPoints: Oral care removes plaque from teeth and along the gumline; brushing, cleaning between teeth, and routine dental care protect function as well as comfort.
Compare care options by function, access, safety, and sustainability; avoid appearance rules, shame, rigid perfection, or assumptions about another person’s habits.
